t: Camera glasses with speakers and microphones that run apps from your phone.
steps: Buy Mentra Live from the official Mentra Store for about 449 US dollars.
Charge the glasses in their case and install the Mentra app on your phone.
Pair the glasses with the app and try a ready-made app such as live captions.
Read the Mentra developer docs and pick the Bluetooth SDK for Mentra Live work.
Check that the SDK version matches the glasses software version.
Install the Bun runtime and VS Code for the miniapp quickstart.
Run the quickstart example and take your first photo from code.
meta: Open Code. From $449. A few stores.
